long_description: Monumint is conversational AI for financial services. We help banks, credit unions, and lenders build lasting customer relationships across the entire customer journey from account opening and loan origination to servicing and collections. Our AI agents are omni-channel, take action inside the systems financial institutions already use, and are built with compliance at their core.
name: Monumint
one_liner: Conversational AI purpose-built for financial services
